title: The Unknown Island
text: Originally, a penguin's joints are tucked inside its body, giving it a skeletal structure you might call a deep crouch—something like a delinquent's squat, I daresay. …Was Father sitting in that very posture as Peckul? Father hoisted himself up almost entirely through flipper-power alone. Watching that figure climb up Ren, then Itsuki… and then finally me… somehow it felt like Father was closing in on me, and I found myself getting rather excited about it.
“Hnngh! There we go!”
“Muhehehe…”
“Motoyasu-san? Please stop flailing your legs about. Why can’t you just hold still!”
As Father climbed up, right at my eye level was Father’s belly. Father’s fluffy belly, indeed! So fluffy! So flufftastic, I say! Sniff sniff, indeed!
“Wait, Motoyasu-kun!?”
“Whoa! It’s shaking!”
Ren couldn’t brace himself in time, and we all toppled forward, sending Father tumbling backward off the pile.
“Watch out!”
“Watch out, nano!”
While we collapsed in a heap with a thud, Rival and Sakura-chan caught Father together.
“What is wrong with you, Motoyasu-san! You can’t even manage something this simple? Are you an idiot?”
“I am not an idiot, indeed! Father’s enchanting belly was right in front of me, so I was simply savoring it, I say.”
“What do you mean ‘enchanting belly’!? This is absolutely ridiculous!”
“Um… Heroes-sama…”
Fiancée raised her hand, looking apologetic.
“Since the heroes-sama are small right now, why don’t we lift you up instead?”
“That’d be better, nano. Spear Hero can’t sit still, so we should just get this over with quickly, nano.”
“Yeah… it’d be easier on me too if someone just lifted me up.”
“Honestly, why didn’t we do that from the start?”
And so, one by one, we were each hoisted up and placed onto the pedestal that was Ren.
“Itsuki-sama.”
“Rishia-san. Setting me aside, I really do think this is Motoyasu-san’s fault.”
Itsuki, still looking unconvinced, was placed atop Ren by Riska. Next was my turn, and Yuki-chan scooped me up and set me atop Itsuki.
“Yuki-san. Since Motoyasu-san keeps thrashing about, please hold him steady until we get Naofumi-san up there too.”
“Understood! Motoyasu-sama, please endure it just a little longer.”
Yuki-chan held me steady. And it’s not as though I have no reason to be restless, mind you—it’s simply that our foundation, Ren, is far too flimsy, I say.
“Naofumi, here we go~”
“Please, Sakura-chan.”

And so Father, carried up by Sakura-chan, was placed on top of me. I could feel Father’s fluffiness pressed intensely against the back of my head—right around the part meant for keeping eggs warm, no less. So toasty, I say!
“…Still no effect.”
“If that mural turned out to be a dud, I’m going to lose it.”
“Yuki-san, Sakura-san, please let go and step back. Maybe you’re not supposed to be supporting us.”
“I hate to let go, but understood.”
“Okaaay~”
Yuki-chan and the others promptly released their hold and stepped back… and nothing in particular happened.
“…Nothing’s happening.”
“There’s no way they’d build up that much suspense for nothing.”
“This riddle part is so frustrating… what else could we possibly be missing?”
“Heroes, isn’t it maybe that the tools this statue’s holding are wrong, nano?”
“Ah… you mean we need to match those too?”
“That’s part of the riddle too?”
“If we get it right, it’d be nice if it went ‘cha-la-ri-cha-la-ran~’ or something obvious like that, but let’s just try it.”
Mine was a hoe! Something like a shovel—easy enough, I say!
“A saw… that dropped from a boss, if I recall.”
“I had a rope stashed in my weapon before entering the dungeon.”
“A fishing rod… I definitely don’t have that one.”
“It wasn’t among the drops either, was it?”
“I’ll go buy one real quick, so please wait here.”
Fiancée dashed off to the market and came back. And so, Father held a fishing rod—but still, nothing happened.
“…A dud, I suppose. Just in case, let’s all try putting these into our weapons and equipping them.”

In line with Itsuki’s meticulous demands, Father and the others fed the items into their weapons to transform them. Suddenly, something surged crackling through our bodies. The area around the totem, along with the ground beneath us, began to glow. A flash raced across the ground like red lightning, and a rumbling sound started up—goro, goro… At the same moment, the eyes of the frontier animal carved into the totem lit up.
“Looks like that was the correct answer after all. I really wish this could’ve ended with just the shoulder-riding, though.”

We abandoned our human pyramid and headed toward the source of the noise. And there, beyond the shore, part of the sea itself was churning and heaving wildly. Then, with a tremendous roar of splashing water, a new island rose up from the depths, exactly as depicted in the mural!
“What is that!?”
“A new island!?”
“There were those creatures earlier, the ones people call the natives of Cal Mira Island.”
“Sounds like the heroes did it. Apparently that hero’s been solving the island’s mysteries.”
“Amazing…”

Such voices reached my ears. Being an Usaunny, my hearing was excellent. It struck me again—humans truly have different senses from other beings. This must be the world as Older Sister and Keel and the others perceived it.
“Seems like it worked.”
“Wow… I don’t know how to put it, but this really feels like a proper adventure, doesn’t it?”
“Yeah, it really does…”
“Let’s go already, nano!”

Rival spread her wings wide with a great whoosh and took off flying. We set our course straight for the newly risen island. Naturally, with the island’s sudden appearance, the adventurers and other people who had been nearby began cautiously making their way toward it as well.
“An unknown island. Mother would absolutely insist on coming here.”
“Didn’t she say she was too busy to make it?”
“Yes. But I think she’ll rush over the moment she clears her schedule.”

Fiancée, riding on Sakura-chan’s back, answered while looking over at Father, who swam alongside them. As though it were the most natural thing in the world, Father was swimming along. I, meanwhile, was traveling on Yuki-chan’s back. Submarine mode would have worked fine too, but riding on Yuki-chan’s back wasn’t bad either, I say.
“Naofumi’s fast~”
Sakura-chan, paddling along the water’s surface with her feet, watched Father swim past gracefully with her eyes.
“Naofumi, has Peckul gotten used to it, nano?”
“Yeah. I can swim pretty fast now. Since I can switch back anytime, it’ll probably come in handy for swimming with everyone.”
“Really is fast, nano. Looks fun, nano.”
“Personally, I can’t swim, so please spare me from this.”
“That’s right, that’s right.”
Ren and Itsuki traveled by flying on Rival’s back.
“Setting Ren aside, Itsuki, wouldn’t it be better for you to fly too?”
“Please don’t make me remember something I’d rather forget.”
“Sounds like there were all sorts of discoveries in that dungeon, nano. Good thing, nano. Gaelion will have Naofumi teach various things later and remember them for future use, nano.”
“Naofumi-san! Please be careful! Otherwise the rest of us are going to end up in serious trouble!”
Amid such exchanges, we arrived at the new island.
“First one here, indeed!”

I stepped ashore onto the island. No plants had grown yet, but since it had been underwater, patches of seaweed and coral remained scattered here and there, giving the illusion of still walking along the ocean floor.
“This has its own kind of beauty, doesn’t it. I wonder if there are any monsters around.”
“If the activation phenomenon has adapted to this island too, it’d be scary if monsters started popping up.”
As we advanced, we didn’t spot anything resembling monsters in particular. However… we did notice scattered traces of what looked like the remnants of stone pillars—signs of some past habitation.
“It’s got the look of an island that sank all on its own. If it sank overnight, that’d be kind of romantic, don’t you think? Though who knows how it actually happened.”
“I wonder what it really is. Actually, come to think of it… doesn’t this island seem to be giving off some incredible energy?”
You could clearly see something like a crimson aura emanating from the island. Perhaps it would be more accurate to say the activation phenomenon was erupting from it.
